time("7:00am"; "7:30am"; "8:00am"; "8:30am").
customers("Felicia"; "Isabel"; "Ora"; "Tricia").

% For each customer, they place exactly one order with one bread and one time.
{order(Customer, Bread, Time): breads(Bread), time(Time)}=1 :- customers(Customer).

% No option in any category will ever be used more than once.
:- order(C1,B1,T1), order(C2,B2,T2), C1 != C2, B1 = B2, T1 = T2.
:- order(C1,B1,T1), order(C2,B2,T2), C1 = C2, B1 != B2, T1 = T2.
:- order(C1,B1,T1), order(C2,B2,T2), C1 = C2, B1 = B2, T1 != T2.

% 1. The person who came in at 8:00am asked for wheat bread.
order(C, "wheat bread", "8:00am") :- customers(C).

% 2. Tricia came in a half-hour after Ora.
:- order("Tricia", _, T1), order("Ora", _, T2), T1 = T2 + 0.5.

% 3.1 Felicia and the customer who ordered flatbread are different.
:- order("Felicia", _, _), order(C, "flatbread", _), C = "Felicia".

% 3.2 Felicia came in at 7:30am or came in at 7:00am.
{time("7:00am"); time("7:30am")}=1 :- order("Felicia", _, T).

% 3.3 The customer who ordered flatbread came in at 7:30am or came in at 7:00am.
{time("7:00am"); time("7:30am")}=1 :- order(C, "flatbread", T).

% 4.1 The customer who ordered wheat bread and the person who ordered pumpernickel are different.
:- order(C1, "wheat bread", _), order(C2, "pumpernickel", _), C1 = C2.

% 4.2 The customer who ordered wheat bread came in at 8:30am or was Tricia.
{time("8:30am"); customers("Tricia")}=1 :- order(C, "wheat bread", T).

% 4.3 The person who ordered pumpernickel came in at 8:30am or was Tricia.
{time("8:30am"); customers("Tricia")}=1 :- order(C, "pumpernickel", T).
